prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 2 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Option 3 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 4 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Option 5 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 6 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import requests


class IBMAppIDFederatedProfileClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
        client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
        region: Optional[str] = None,
        appid_instance_id: Optional[str] = None,
        session: Optional[requests.Session] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.client_id = client_id or os.getenv("IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID")
        self.client_secret = client_secret or os.getenv("IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET")
        self.region = region or os.getenv("IBM_APPID_REGION", "us-south")
        self.appid_instance_id = appid_instance_id or os.getenv("IBM_APPID_INSTANCE_ID")
        self.session = session or requests.Session()

        if not self.client_id or not self.client_secret:
            raise ValueError("IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID and IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET are required")

    def _base_url(self) -> str:
        if self.appid_instance_id:
            return f"https://{self.appid_instance_id}.{self.region}.appid.cloud.ibm.com"
        return f"https://{self.region}.appid.cloud.ibm.com"

    def _token(self, authorization_code: str, redirect_uri: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        url = f"{self._base_url()}/oauth/v4/21/token"
        data = {
            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
            "code": authorization_code,
            "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "client_secret": self.client_secret,
        }
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"}
        resp = self.session.post(url, data=data, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        token_data = resp.json()
        if "access_token" not in token_data:
            raise ValueError("No access_token returned by IBM App ID")
        return token_data

    def _userinfo(self, access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        url = f"{self._base_url()}/oauth/v4/21/userinfo"
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"}
        resp = self.session.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        normalized: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "subject": claims.get("sub") or claims.get("subject") or claims.get("user_id"),
            "email": claims.get("email"),
            "email_verified": claims.get("email_verified"),
            "given_name": claims.get("given_name") or claims.get("first_name"),
            "family_name": claims.get("family_name") or claims.get("last_name"),
            "name": claims.get("name")
            or " ".join(
                part
                for part in [
                    claims.get("given_name") or claims.get("first_name"),
                    claims.get("family_name") or claims.get("last_name"),
                ]
                if part
            )
            or claims.get("preferred_username"),
            "preferred_username": claims.get("preferred_username") or claims.get("username"),
            "picture": claims.get("picture"),
            "locale": claims.get("locale"),
            "claims": claims,
        }

        identity = claims.get("identity") or claims.get("identities")
        if identity is not None:
            normalized["identity"] = identity

        return normalized

    def fetch_normalized_profile(
        self,
        authorization_code: str,
        redirect_uri: str,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        token_data = self._token(authorization_code, redirect_uri)
        userinfo = self._userinfo(token_data["access_token"])

        merged_claims: Dict[str, Any] = dict(token_data)
        merged_claims.update(userinfo)

        normalized = self._normalize_claims(merged_claims)
        normalized["access_token"] = token_data.get("access_token")
        normalized["id_token"] = token_data.get("id_token")
        normalized["token_type"] = token_data.get("token_type")
        normalized["expires_in"] = token_data.get("expires_in")
        return normalized


def fetch_federated_user_profile_claims(
    authorization_code: str,
    redirect_uri: str,
    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
    client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
    region: Optional[str] = None,
    appid_instance_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = IBMAppIDFederatedProfileClient(
        client_id=client_id,
        client_secret=client_secret,
        region=region,
        appid_instance_id=appid_instance_id,
    )
    return client.fetch_normalized_profile(authorization_code, redirect_uri)
